messages:
michael: Auditor Lina pinged — they want a tight evidence bundle that ties the infra RBAC patch to KMS usage for SOC2. Minimal, replayable, sanitized. Can someone take ownership?

tara: I can. What exact artifacts do they want?

auditor_lina: Short list: 1) infra PR that changed role bindings (link + approver + timestamp), 2) change approval ticket, 3) KMS key policy JSON, 4) sanitized CloudTrail or Splunk snippets showing kms:Decrypt/kms:GenerateDataKey events against the CMK, 5) KMS rotation log (CSV or screenshot) + CMK ARN, 6) SIEM correlation showing alert -> principal -> key, and 7) rollback proof (decrypt succeeds before, AccessDenied after). Prefer replay scripts.

sam: I'll grab the PR/ticket refs. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/538 (binding: svc-encoder -> kms-decrypt). Ticket: JIRA INF-7420, approved by @sam at 2024-11-07T10:22:00Z.

tara: Good. I'll prepare key policy JSON export and a small envelope-encryption diagram.

sam: Draft Splunk query (will sanitize):
```splunk
index=aws_cloudtrail eventName IN (Decrypt,GenerateDataKey) requestParameters.keyId="arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:333333333333:key/abcd1234"
| table _time userIdentity.principalId eventName requestParameters.keyId errorMessage
| sort _time
```

tara: Sanitization jq example to strip ARNs/account ids:
```bash
jq 'map({time:.eventTime, principal:.userIdentity.type, event:.eventName, key:.requestParameters.keyId})' raw-cloudtrail.json > sanitized-kms.json
```

auditor_lina: Include a manifest.txt with filenames, SHA256, and mapping: control -> file -> short proof statement. Also list principals allowed to rotate keys.

sam: KMS rotation export will be CSV from AWS CLI. I'll include CMK ARN and an access list. Also add the SIEM rule ID: SIEM-2024-6205 and a small alert replay (redacted).

tara: For rollback proof we'll run this locally and capture output (redact acct ids):
```bash
# before revert (svc-encoder role)
aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://ct.bin --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:333333333333:key/abcd1234 --profile svc-encoder
# expect: Decryption OK (plaintext)

# perform revert (remove role binding)
# after revert
aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://ct.bin --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:333333333333:key/abcd1234 --profile svc-encoder
# expect: An AccessDenied/NotAuthorized error (redact details)
```

sam: Evidence upload path per ops-bot: s3://redwood-secure-evidence/INF-7420/2024-11-07. Use presigned URLs (48h) and label files per manifest.

sec-bot: Reminder: sanitize all logs to remove PII/PHI and account IDs. Use evidence bucket and manifest.

tara: ETA: draft bundle by Thursday EOD. Owners: sam (PR/ticket + rotation export + manifest), tara (key policy + sanitized logs + replay scripts), michael (bundle assembly + upload). I'll post presigned link here when ready.

auditor_lina: Thanks  if possible include a one-page runbook with step-by-step playback instructions for the artifacts. We may request a 20min call to replay.

michael: Copy. We'll keep it compact and replayable. Thanks all :thumbsup:
